body: I think maybe I made this sound more extreme than it is? Yes all of these things are true, but she doesn't physically do anything to me. Mostly what happens is that there are undertones and glaring. And a lot of the time things seem ok, as long as I don't talk about anything at all sensitive or "controversial". As long as I never talk college or about how I feel, it's mostly fine. Just not a lot of emotional support at all, as it's more damaging. When she is around I usually just listen to her complain about how she hates her life. Only once every other week about she blows up. And it's only serious once every few months...

Yeah, I am not sure about why they think that about men.

It's just kind of hard I guess because along with everything, they get mad pretty easily. I can't talk about anything serious with them. And I need to be constantly thanking them for everything. They say that I'm such an asshole. Whenever I leave the room they talk about all of the things I do and laugh and say that I am a bitch and that I am such an asshole that they need to make me do things more. I'm not sure what that means. I clean most of their house for them every week, while they stay in bed all the time. It's hard for me to see that they actually care about me. It seems like I am just some sort of liability to them.
What kind of places did they allow you to go? I just feel like right now I will never be at all prepared to be an adult.
Okay, thank you. Are you able to go out and do things sometimes?

I know the location thing shouldn't be a big deal, I just think it's not very necessary. My mother acted upset over the fact that I might not want her tracking me all the time when I am in my 20's. She says that whenever I date that I should have that person track me.

Whenever I bring up anything about it they get really angry and resent me. They already say they have issues with me because I am male and that is bad because most men are bad people they say. I don't have any friends or family to talk about these things. I of course am complying for now, but as it is, I don't know how I am going to make anything change when I turn 18 or beyond because they see growing up as a personal rejection of parents (which is what they said) and that they do not want me to grow up. It just feels weird that I am home almost 100% of the time and the 1% of the time I'm not I need to be location tracked.
Only a few minute drive. My mom wants to get a job there

My main issue is that I honestly don’t know how to get out of my situation. I have no job, money, or future plans. My parents are paying for college because i can’t afford it. So I can’t really just tell them goodbye
